notes.title: Patch Notes - FA003
notes.notes:
Small patch today.

As always, feel free to join us in the Steam forums for any questions, comments, or bug reports.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Performance boost from FX object pooling: Specifically created to help Mission 7 Drone Test Day performance issue, but there should be boost in performance across the game in any scene with bullet impacts.
[*]AMD graphics fix: The "previous_version" beta branch that was opened to allow AMD graphics card users to play the game while we worked through some issues is no longer available as we have addressed all the issues reported. All users that were subscribed to the beta branch will be updated to the latest version of the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - FA001
notes.notes:
Patch FA001 making its final approach...

We pushed our first patch today and it is available for download now. As with all Steam games by default, Final Approach will be updated automatically to get you the latest features, bug fixes, and improvements!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Instant Zoom Out Button: Pressing the menu button on the Right Vive Controller will instantly zoom you out of any zoom point without needing to open the Flypad.
[*] Added voice over to tutorial teaching how to use the instant zoom out button.
[*] Mission 15: Added drop off indicator to aircraft carrier that appears when a helicopter is carrying people.
[*] Mission 15: Helicopter magnetic cables automatically drop people off when near aircraft carrier drop off position.
[/list]
